en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a large historic castle complex with thick stone walls, a round central tower with a conical roof, and various gabled roofs and windows. The castle stands on a slope above trees and gardens. At the bottom center of the front side, printed text reads "Zschopau. Schloß Wildeck". The overall design and printing style suggest an early-20th‑century European postcard.
